question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Blue blood
solution:
The correct answer is **'Noble birth'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Blue blood'** is **'Noble birth'.**
 
• **Blue blood:** membership in a noble or socially prominent family. (एक कुलीन या सामाजिक रूप से प्रमुख परिवार में सदस्यता)
 
 
• *Example: He has **blue blood,** which gives his cheeks a blue tinge.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Noble birth.*
